text.title: Second-Best Weather
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_mood: Wry, wounded, quietly jealous, self-aware → tender, resigned, strangely dignified
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar in a minor busker pattern, soft lo-fi hip-hop drums with brushed snare and muted kick, warm upright bass entering after first hook, sparse piano notes after second verse, faint tape hiss and room tone, tiny glitch artifacts tucked into transitions as emotional “misfires, ” subtle reverse swells before hooks, full-stop dropouts before blunt punchlines, final third adds soft harmonies and a low analog pad, staying raw
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male vocal, close-mic spoken-word rap verses with conversational phrasing, restrained bitterness softened by dry humor, half-sung indie-folk hook with fragile warmth, occasional whispered doubles on “second-best” and “almost, ” slight rasp on exposed lines, final section more melodic and accepting without becoming triumphant

transcription.text: I hope this talent, not useful exactly, more like a cursed party trick. I meet someone right before the flower part, and somehow I become the frost warning. I have watched so many beginnings peck their bags in my hallway, she's still warm, laughs still hanging, tea not even cold yet, and there it goes. The small green thing, deciding against spring. I arrive with my little lantern, my careful jokes, my no pressure, honestly, my emotionally responsible shoes, and still the room starts looking for and exit. A door doesn't always slam, sometimes it just learns your name. In a quieter font, maybe I bloom too loudly, maybe I lean toward the light, maybe I call it connection, when it was only a night, I'm always the almost, and nearly the rain, the second best weather outside, someone's main, I'm never the first call when the roof starts to bend down, everyone's almost, and no one's best friend, which is fine, statistically rude, but fine. There is a special kind of loneliness and being trusted, but not chosen, like being handed the spare key to a house, you're not invited to live in. I know where the cups are, I know which joysticks, I know the story behind the scar on the table, but when the real storm comes, when the phone lights up at 2.13, when the world splits open, and someone needs a voice, it's not mine. I'm the backup generator with feelings, the person they call, when their person is unavailable in God, that sentence has a basement. I've been the porch light for people who went home elsewhere, the understudy heart, learning everyone's lines, just in case, the lead gets sick. Maybe I'll make myself useful, when I want it to be loved, maybe I stood near the doorway, and called that close enough, I'm always the almost, and nearly the rain, the second best weather outside someone's main, I'm never the first call when the roof starts to bend down, everyone's almost, and no one's best friend, I tried to debug it once, made a list, very healthy, very normal, column A, things I did wrong, column B, things I probably did wrong, but with better lighting, column C, acts of God, poor timing, emotional band, with and whatever curse, makes people say you're so important to me, with the energy of a closing tab, I keep trying to find the line where closeness fails to converge, the hidden axiom, the bad variable, the crooked little, if then the turns stay in to take care. Maybe my end to two open, maybe your end to two guard, maybe I make people feel seen, and then paddock, when they look back, maybe I'm easy to confess to, and difficult to need, that one hurt, put a little reverb on that, and the worst part is, I don't wanna be, someone's everything, that sounds exhausting, I don't need a throne, I don't need a crown, I don't need my name, written across another person's sky, I just want, one side to be the obvious choice, not the clever one, not the safe one, not the strangely articulate hallway, between one lock and another, I want someone to say, without checking the weather, without scrolling past my name, there you are, I was looking for you, so I keep a garden of our muscles, little buds of our biography, failed to understand, but I'll go with them, that particularly fruit and produced a very popular leaf, it was the one who laughed, like the wind opened, then it closed, so gently, I apologized, blached, it was the one who said it was home, that moved emotionally, without leaving, a forwarding address, there was the one who made me feel centered, until I realized, I was bordering again, then there were friends, beautiful, impossible friends, contrasting with the darkness, but not their daylight, they tell me I'm madder, I believe them mostly, that there is a quiet rift, let's dig, in every room and I can count, I know, the difference between warmth and priority, I know the sound of my name, arriving second, I'm tired of almost getting here, we've arrived, our second best weather outside someone's late, but I'll keep alive, I'm not great, just enough for the tools, the might, I'll be not though eating a shot, open to find the almost, the nearly friend, the one who could touch hold, again and again, I'll still grow strange flowers, with the old ones who then close doors, can't stop spring, from trying again, so no hard feelings, you had your person, I had a lot of time, but somewhere between the knock and the echo, I must hope the hallway, for an invitation, again,
